vulnerability.name: USN-8352-1
vulnerability.description: Duc Anh Nguyen discovered that LibreOffice incorrectly handled mismatched encryption salt parameters in crafted OOXML documents. An attacker could use this issue to cause LibreOffice to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: LibreOffice could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it opened a specially crafted file.
